name: What is the typical cost of a kitchen remodel in Berkeley and East Bay?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of a kitchen remodel in Berkeley and East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen remodel in Berkeley and the East Bay varies significantly based on the scope of work, materials chosen, and the size of your kitchen. A minor remodel might range from $25,000 to $45,000, while a major renovation with high-end finishes could cost $75,000 or more. Factors like custom cabinetry, countertop materials, appliance upgrades, and structural changes all impact the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen remodel costs in Berkeley and East Bay vary, typically ranging from $25,000 for minor updates to over $75,000 for major renovations.
